ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low macro-level ratio; predominantly low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels covering >95% of visible surface with high-intensity pixels localized to distal tips and circular marks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark pigmentation (near-black) across both lobes; high-contrast tan/white textured blobs at the lateral tips; several light-grey circular ring-marks located on the upper-central left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression; internal vertex angle approximately 45-50 degrees; significant depth extending towards the submerged peduncle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude jagged boundary; irregular peaks and valleys ranging from 10-30 pixels in relative height across the entire length from notch to tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the superior margin of both lobes, tapering into narrow distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-contrast, textured circular blobs (barnacle colonies) on far-left and far-right distal tips; 4-6 faint circular depigmented ring scars visible on the left lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on distal tips; healed circular parasitic or attachment scars on the left lobe surface.
